o.text: Ultimately from Arabic صِفْر (ṣifr, “zero”). Doublet of şifr.
From Proto-Common Turkic *tikö (“piece”). Compare Turkish tike (“piece”), Turkmen tike, Kyrgyz тике (tike), биртике (birtike, “a little bit”), Khalaj tike, Karakhanid تِكُو (tikǖ, “piece, slice”).
Borrowed from Arabic عُضْوِيّ (ʕuḍwiyy). By surface analysis, üzv + -i
